Fixture discovery returns one normalized record with role identities, scenario eligibility and a single count field named count. Validate role existence and coupon prerequisites before declaring readiness. A missing required role produces BLOCKED with the missing prerequisite; optional absence is recorded explicitly. Producers and consumers read count, not competing count aliases.

The role table is the only authorization authority. Never authorize from user_metadata or a profile mirror. Superadmin creation is console-only; no app-side superadmin creation route is provided. Retire the metadata-authorized add-user, delete-user and get-users recipes. Future privileged list/delete operations remain possible only with trusted current-role lookup, operation-local authorization before elevated capability, an approved target-role allowlist and privileged-target protection. Profile mirrors contain profile data, not authorization columns. Registration metadata is not authorization.

At the trusted public-signup boundary, allow only approved profile fields and force the member role independently of submitted metadata. The provider-side creation path must also ignore or reject public role keys, so direct provider signup cannot bypass the endpoint. Privileged role assignment uses a separately authorized protected channel. Trigger hardening and a negative direct-provider test are required before promotion: role=admin submitted publicly must not produce an admin.

Server guards control page access; server-resolved { user, role } props establish first-render identity. Retire client HOC route protection and post-mount identity fetching as authoritative patterns. Zustand handles interaction and session-event reactions, with no persisted authorization authority. Display helpers are display-only and use explicit role sets; they never authorize an operation.

Do not persist raw contact details by default. Any approved personal-data persistence declares permitted fields, retention duration and user or guest scope. Sign-out and account transition reset and invalidate every affected store even when remote logout fails; a new account must not hydrate the previous account’s data. Payment and authorization state remain outside persistence. Storage readiness is separate from business-data reset.

The browser may display or poll payment status; it may not choose paid or processing state. A payment-derived transition requires verified server-side evidence bound to the stored order and payment attempt, including amount and currency. Non-webhook mutations authenticate and authorize the operation and target, including an explicitly approved guest capability where supported, then validate the state transition.

Make effects idempotent or transactional. A bounded lease/recovery process reclaims abandoned work and reconciles partial external success without duplicating completed effects.

Services return an explicit typed outcome: success, not-found, unavailable, invalid or forbidden. Routes map it to the approved HTTP/UI behavior with generic client messages and no upstream error text. Do not cache failures as successful public data. Degrade or fail closed according to the module’s approved failure policy; an unavailable entitlement read is not confirmed absence.

A fixed-product coupon uses validated eligible line items and quantities in the authoritative server pricing operation. Do not advertise fixed_product through a flat-cart subtotal branch. A client calculation is a display estimate only. Verify equal-subtotal carts with different eligible quantities; preserve valid fixed-cart and percentage behavior.

Accept product/variation identifiers, quantities, shipping selection and coupon code, never caller prices, shipping costs or discount amounts. Validate quantities and product eligibility; load authoritative catalog prices; validate the shipping selection and coupon eligibility; apply the declared tax policy; calculate currency-safe totals on the server. Bind the payment to the authorized order and verify payment identity, amount, currency and order association before marking paid. Client totals are display-only. Return generic failures and redact logs. Universal quote-storage design is deferred; the required server pricing and payment binding still apply.
